input.question: Who is the artist of the song "Shy Boy"?

documents.text: Poland , where Melua 's preceding singles `` Spider 's Web `` and `` It 's Only Pain `` reached the top five on the airplay chart , and Piece by Piece lead single `` Nine Million Bicycles `` topped the chart . After 3 weeks on charting below the Top 20 , the single finally peaked at # 1 in Polish National Top 50 , making `` Shy Boy '' her second number one single in Poland .
